name: canonify-springml
description: Build Canonify screens in SpringML: a .springml file of HTML-like JSX whose only elements are the Spring UI names over data the page declares (Query, Record, Aggregate, State, Preview). The server evaluates the page for each reader and the renderer owns every pixel; a screen whose layout is the data (a calendar, a schedule) is a Region your code draws over the same per-reader model. Read SKILL.md first, then the language page, the component reference, verbs and forms, the recipes and regions.

resources.title: The SpringML language
resources.description: The file, the data elements (Query as the collection and its handles, Record, Aggregate with day series, State, Preview), row predicates and render expressions, binding to the model's names, withheld columns, Rule C and not-run Queries, the readback and the refusals, caps.

resources.title: Spring UI components (generated)
resources.description: Generated from the catalog schema: every Spring UI name an author writes, with its kind, summary, parents, children, props and one example page that compiles; the helpers, handles and scope names; which names the renderer does not draw yet.

resources.title: Verbs and forms
resources.description: Action placement and subjects, scope fill and with, legality (machine, offeredWhen, grants), verbs that follow the flag and preCheck, BulkAction over invoke_many, Check; Form, Field, Step, Submit with next, Preview, Lines with seedFrom, Candidates, and the model keys behind them.

resources.title: Recipes
resources.description: Whole screens of a city library (and a sports club), each a real page that compiles and renders: a record page, a capacity page with the exception loud, a hold-shelf queue, fines with presets and totals, a list with bulk verbs and an expandable row, a week chart, files, availability over a chosen range (the busiest day, free capacity, a guard that names the day), par vs stock over a chosen range, and a need against an actual per row and day.

resources.title: Regions
resources.description: When a screen's layout is the data (a calendar, a schedule, a board of nested marks): the Region element, its module and the platform calls, the per-reader model it draws (rows, faults, values, mine, days, words, verbs), the look (ui's tokens and classes) and the checks the author loop and catalog.apply run.
